entries.reason: the port declares it and sends six of its methods: RevenantAVPlayerPictureInPictureRelay in AVPlayerViewController.m adopts it and implements the will/did start, the will/did stop, the failed-to-start and the restore-user-interface callbacks, which AVPictureInPictureController.m then sends around both transitions. The row said the protocol was not there and that NSProtocolFromString would answer nil; that was wrong
entries.effect: the protocol object is in the library, so NSProtocolFromString answers it and a delegate's conformsToProtocol: answers YES; the six methods the port sends are the ones a 9.0 delegate implements, and a delegate that implements more of them is called for nothing this port sends
